## Type

- [ ] Content (matrix techniques, framework/theory essays) — `content/**`

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`npm run test`)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check` pass
- [ ] Content validates (`npm run validate:content`) — if content changed
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or structure changed
- [ ] Follows the engineering standards (`docs/engineering-standards/`) and style guide
- [ ] Commits signed off (DCO: `git commit -s`)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or PII added
